cakemaker2_onboarding_1_text: Bake delicious sponge layers, prepare tasty creams and fillings, and mix and match them to create your perfect cake!
cakemaker2_onboarding_2_text: Unlock new flavors and recipes, build amazing layered cakes, and add colorful toppings and decorations to make every cake unique!
more_apps_game_cars1_desc: Become a speedy racecar driver, a fearless pilot, or a brave ship captain. Choose your favorite vehicle and set off on an exciting journey!
more_apps_game_cars2_desc: With Cars 2, you can choose any cool vehicle from your garage and customize it: paint, choose wheels, stickers, and other accessories! And once your car is ready, it's time to hit the track!
more_apps_game_dino1_desc: Explore Dino Island and meet our friendly dinosaurs! Feed a hungry diplodocus, fly with a playful pterodactyl, and learn many interesting facts along the way!
more_apps_game_dino2_desc: Discover the wonders of Dino Island 2 and make new friends! Have fun at the velociraptor's birthday party, build sandcastles with iguanodon, and uncover fascinating facts about these prehistoric creatures!
more_apps_game_mingle_mangle_desc: Fun Sorting presents a great collection of sorting and classifying activities. Find out where cute animals live, listen to soothing lullabies, and complete colorful puzzles to make pictures come to life!
more_apps_game_coloring_desc: Choose from a variety of drawing tools and vivid colors, and enjoy coloring brave superheroes, friendly dinosaurs, and funny aliens with Coloring Book!
more_apps_game_boats_desc: From a pirate ship and small fishing boat to a fancy speedboat and big submarine — choose any vessel you like and embark on an exciting journey!
more_apps_game_farm_desc: Many kinds of domestic and wild animals await you on a little farm, in a green forest, and sunny savannah. And don't forget to meet some cute insects in the garden and learn the names of fruit and vegetables!
more_apps_game_puzzles_desc: Police car, ice cream truck, or a taxi? Choose any car you like, customize it, solve puzzles, and explore different locations. Let's go on a new adventure!
more_apps_game_shapes_desc: With many educational activities in Shapes & Colors, studying becomes fun! Learn what different shapes look like, match and sort them by size and color!
more_apps_school_of_magic_desc: Have lots of fun while studying numbers, patterns, shapes, and colors at our magic school! Attend classes to mix potions, cast spells, fly broomsticks, and learn through play.
more_apps_color_by_number_desc: Musical instruments, robots, birds, insects, and many more — choose any picture, color it and learn numbers along the way!
more_apps_color_by_code_desc: Color by number, letter, addition, or subtraction! Color by Code offers a wide variety of fun and educational coloring pages that are sure to spark your imagination!
more_apps_easy_coloring_desc: Many coloring pages with funny animals await you in Easy Coloring! Color with a crayon or a brush, connect the dots, or tap blocks to see a colorful picture!
more_apps_easy_puzzles_desc: Enjoy a great collection of educational and engaging activities: meet different animals, learn shapes and colors, complete puzzles, spot the differences in the pictures, and many more!
more_apps_pizza_chef_desc: Are you ready to become a pizza chef? Cut and slice ingredients, make and roll out dough, and put all of your favorite toppings together to make the best pizza!
more_apps_alphabet_desc: Study the English Alphabet with our cheerful Raccoon: practice writing and pronouncing letters, tell the difference between capitals and lowercase, and learn new words!
more_apps_numbers_desc: Develop early math skills in a fun and engaging way! Study numbers and counting up to 10, listen to interesting facts, and practice by playing games!
more_apps_diner_desc: Welcome to Diner! Make delicious dishes and feed your cute animal customers! From burgers and cakes to salads and smoothies, there's something for everyone on the menu!
more_apps_dress_up_desc: Have fun and dress up for any occasion! Many colorful outfits and accessories will help you be whatever you want: a superhero, an artist, or even a dinosaur!
more_apps_1st_grade_math_desc: Discover the world of math through fun learning games! Study shapes, numbers and counting, addition and subtraction, and more!
more_apps_early_math_desc: Have fun and study with Early Math! Lots of tasks and practice to work through: measure and compare size and length, tell time, and learn the difference between flat and solid shapes!
more_apps_planes_desc: Get ready to take to the skies with Planes! Choose your favorite from many different planes, paint and customize, then take it for a spin and soar through the skies!
more_apps_game_coloring2_desc: Pencils, crayons, and brushes are ready! Choose from many cute and fun coloring pages and color your favorite pictures using different vibrant colors and drawing tools.
more_apps_fairy_tales_desc: Welcome to the magical world of fairy tales! Fairy Tales has many stories that you can listen to or read on your own. From "Cinderella" and "Sleeping Beauty" to "The Three Little Pigs," there is something for everyone!
more_apps_fairy_tales2_desc: Fairy Tales 2 is a perfect way to spark your love for reading! With enchanting pictures and engaging narration, you can immerse yourself in the world of fantasy and let your imagination run wild!
more_apps_pet_care_desc: Become a real vet and help poor animals in trouble! Give medicine, treat cuts and splinters, and make our little friends feel better!
more_apps_dino_math_desc: Welcome to Dino Math adventure! Join our Dino on a thrilling journey through the world of addition and subtraction. Solve math problems to be the fastest on a racetrack or the strongest in a robot fight!
more_apps_game_foxy_english_desc: Through many engaging activities and games, Fox will help you learn the basics of English, including the letters and sounds they make, how to read vowels and consonants, and count syllables in words!
more_apps_game_fun_math_desc: Are you ready for a Fun Math adventure? Then, let's go and study shapes, numbers, colors, addition, subtraction, telling time, and many other interesting topics!
more_apps_game_animals_care_desc: Welcome to the amazing world of animals! Meet different animals and learn how to take care of them: feed them their favorite foods, groom them, choose cute outfits, and even help treat their illnesses.
more_apps_game_dino_planet_desc: Meet different dinos and scientists who study them and learn through fun and interactive games! Complete puzzles and spot differences in pictures, count and sort items, recognize shapes and colors, and more!
more_apps_game_music_shop_desc: Let’s visit the Music Shop! It’s a perfect place for those who love music and want to learn how to play different musical instruments: piano, drums, xylophone, and more!
more_apps_game_lullabies_desc: Say goodnight to adorable baby animals! Turn off the light, gently tuck in the blanket, and listen to calming melodies. You can also set a sleep timer and choose which songs to play when you fall asleep.
more_apps_game_construction_cars_desc: Do you like big construction cars? Then let's go to our garage! You can customize, choose wheels, paint, and add stickers to dump trucks, bulldozers, graders, and many other vehicles!
more_apps_game_balloons_desc: Look! So many colorful balloons are flying in the sky! Pop them and see if there’s something inside.
more_apps_game_sounds_around_desc: Tune your ears into the world around you! From the sounds of a busy city, to the soothing sounds of the sea, all the way to the familiar sounds of home, there's so much to discover. Animal choirs are just waiting to be heard too!
more_apps_game_pixel_art_coloring_desc: Enjoy a pixel art coloring book, and learn numbers and letters at the same time! Pick from our collection of coloring pages, featuring animals, cars, sweets, and more. Then color them by matching numbers or letters. It's fun, and you'll learn, too!

more_apps_help_SyncData_question: How can I sync my data between different apps?
more_apps_help_SyncData1_question:
Synchronization between different apps occurs automatically through our servers, ensuring a seamless experience for you. However, if you'd like an additional layer of synchronization, you can also use iCloud Keychain.

iCloud Keychain is a secure and convenient way to sync your data across all your Apple devices. By enabling iCloud Keychain, you easily access your data on multiple devices.

To turn on iCloud Keychain on your iOS device, follow these steps:

1. Tap Settings.
2. Tap your name.
3. Choose iCloud.
4. Tap Passwords and Keychain.
5. Turn on iCloud Keychain. You might be asked for your passcode or Apple ID password.

plashka.more_apps_game_cars2_desc: With Cars 2, you can choose any cool vehicle from your garage and customize it: paint, choose wheels, stickers, and other accessories! And once your car is ready, it's time to hit the track!
plashka.more_apps_game_dino1_desc: Explore Dino Island and meet our friendly dinosaurs! Feed a hungry diplodocus, fly with a playful pterodactyl, and learn many interesting facts along the way!
plashka.more_apps_game_dino2_desc: Discover the wonders of Dino Island 2 and make new friends! Have fun at the velociraptor's birthday party, build sandcastles with iguanodon, and uncover fascinating facts about these prehistoric creatures!
plashka.more_apps_game_mingle_mangle_desc: Fun Sorting presents a great collection of sorting and classifying activities. Find out where cute animals live, listen to soothing lullabies, and complete colorful puzzles to make pictures come to life!
plashka.more_apps_game_coloring_desc: Choose from a variety of drawing tools and vivid colors, and enjoy coloring brave superheroes, friendly dinosaurs, and funny aliens with Coloring Book!
plashka.more_apps_game_boats_desc: From a pirate ship and small fishing boat to a fancy speedboat and big submarine — choose any vessel you like and embark on an exciting journey!
plashka.more_apps_game_farm_desc: Many kinds of domestic and wild animals await you on a little farm, in a green forest, and sunny savannah. And don't forget to meet some cute insects in the garden and learn the names of fruit and vegetables!
plashka.more_apps_game_puzzles_desc: Police car, ice cream truck, or a taxi? Choose any car you like, customize it, solve puzzles, and explore different locations. Let's go on a new adventure!
plashka.more_apps_game_shapes_desc: With many educational activities in Shapes & Colors, studying becomes fun! Learn what different shapes look like, match and sort them by size and color!
plashka.more_apps_school_of_magic_desc: Have lots of fun while studying numbers, patterns, shapes, and colors at our magic school! Attend classes to mix potions, cast spells, fly broomsticks, and learn through play.
plashka.more_apps_color_by_code_desc: Color by number, letter, addition, or subtraction! Color by Code offers a wide variety of fun and educational coloring pages that are sure to spark your imagination!
plashka.more_apps_alphabet_desc: Study the English Alphabet with our cheerful Raccoon: practice writing and pronouncing letters, tell the difference between capitals and lowercase, and learn new words!
plashka.more_apps_numbers_desc: Develop early math skills in a fun and engaging way! Study numbers and counting up to 10, listen to interesting facts, and practice by playing games!
plashka.more_apps_diner_desc: Welcome to Diner! Make delicious dishes and feed your cute animal customers! From burgers and cakes to salads and smoothies, there's something for everyone on the menu!
plashka.more_apps_dress_up_desc: Have fun and dress up for any occasion! Many colorful outfits and accessories will help you be whatever you want: a superhero, an artist, or even a dinosaur!
plashka.more_apps_planes_desc: Get ready to take to the skies with Planes! Choose your favorite from many different planes, paint and customize, then take it for a spin and soar through the skies!
plashka.more_apps_game_coloring2_desc: Pencils, crayons, and brushes are ready! Choose from many cute and fun coloring pages and color your favorite pictures using different vibrant colors and drawing tools.
plashka.more_apps_fairy_tales_desc: Welcome to the magical world of fairy tales! Fairy Tales has many stories that you can listen to or read on your own. From "Cinderella" and "Sleeping Beauty" to "The Three Little Pigs," there is something for everyone!
plashka.more_apps_fairy_tales2_desc: Fairy Tales 2 is a perfect way to spark your love for reading! With enchanting pictures and engaging narration, you can immerse yourself in the world of fantasy and let your imagination run wild!
plashka.more_apps_game_music_shop_desc: Let’s visit the Music Shop! It’s a perfect place for those who love music and want to learn how to play different musical instruments: piano, drums, xylophone, and more!
plashka.more_apps_game_sounds_around_desc: Tune your ears into the world around you! From the sounds of a busy city, to the soothing sounds of the sea, all the way to the familiar sounds of home, there's so much to discover. Animal choirs are just waiting to be heard too!

settings.more_apps_help_GamesStillLocked_question: I have a subscription, but the games are still locked
settings.more_apps_help_GamesStillLocked_all_answ:
Follow these instructions to restore your purchases. Please make sure that the device you're using is signed in with the same Google Play account that was used for the purchase.
1. Open the Amaya game you originally purchased from on your device.
2. Tap For Parents at the top-right corner of the screen.
3. Tap Restore Purchase in Settings.
Please note: it needs to be done from the game originally used for purchasing.
settings.more_apps_help_AdditionalDevices_questio: How do I connect additional devices?
settings.more_apps_help_AdditionalDevices_all_ans:
1. Take the device you've made your purchase from.
2. Open the Amaya game you originally purchased from on your device.
3. Tap For Parents at the top-right corner of the screen.
4. Tap Account and then Create Account (skip if already done).
5. Take the device you wish to connect.
6. Tap For Parents at the top-right corner of the screen.
7. Tap Sign In and log in to your account.
settings.more_apps_help_ManageDevices_question: How do I manage my devices?
settings.more_apps_help_ManageDevices_all_answer:
You can connect only 3 devices to your Amaya+ Subscription.
1. Take the device you've made your purchase from.
2. Tap For Parents at the top-right corner of the screen.
3. Tap Account.
4. If you haven't created an account yet, tap Create Account.
5. Scroll down and remove the relevant devices.
settings.more_apps_help_RestoreIsNotWorking_all_a:
You can restore your purchase from the game you originally purchased from. Before proceeding, please make sure to log out of the current Amaya account your device is connected to.
Once you see which game you purchased from, please access that specific game and restore purchase from there.
settings.more_apps_help_CreateAccount_question: How do I create an account?
settings.more_apps_help_CreateAccount1_answer:
1. Open any Amaya game you have on your device.
2. Tap For Parents at the top-right corner of the screen.
3. Tap Account.
4. Tap Create Account.
settings.more_apps_help_ForgotPassword_answer:
1. Open any Amaya game you have on your device.
2. Tap For Parents at the top-right corner of the screen.
3. Tap Sign In.
4. Tap Forgot Password.
settings.more_apps_help_SyncData_question: How can I sync my data between different apps?
settings.more_apps_help_SyncData1_question:
Synchronization between different apps occurs automatically through our servers, ensuring a seamless experience for you.
To make sure your data syncs correctly across your devices, please ensure that you are signed in with the same Google account on all devices and in all apps.
If you are using multiple Android devices:
1. Open Settings on your device.
2. Tap Accounts (or Passwords & accounts, depending on your device).
3. Make sure you are signed in with the same Google account on each device.
4. Once the same Google account is used, your data should sync automatically.
settings.more_apps_help_ChangePassword_question: How do I change my password?
settings.more_apps_help_ChangePassword_all_questi:
1. Open the Amaya game you originally purchased from on your device.
2. Tap For Parents at the top-right corner of the screen.
3. Tap Account.
4. Tap Edit next to the password field.
